links.basis: 1324/2025. (IX. 3.) Korm. határozat adopts the 2025–2030 strategy.
1573/2020. (IX. 9.) Korm. határozat adopts the 2020–2030 strategy.
The 2025–2030 strategy is the revision of the 2020 strategy; §2.2 asks why a review was needed.
The 2020 strategy was issued by the Ministry for Innovation and Technology.
The 2025 strategy was published by the Ministry for National Economy.
Act LXXV of 2025 implements Regulation (EU) 2024/1689 in Hungarian law.
Bill T/12632, submitted 2025-09-23, was enacted as Act LXXV of 2025.
344/2025. (X. 31.) Korm. rendelet executes the Act: designates authorities, converts the fine ceilings to forint, sets conformity assessment.
The Act creates the Hungarian AI Council.
The Act creates a regulatory sandbox running to August 2026.
1301/2024 set the implementation model and ordered a bill by 2024-11-30 — a deadline that was missed; the Act arrived in 2025.
1301/2024 places the single implementing organisation under the Minister for the Economy.
1149/2025 assigns market surveillance and the AI contact point to the Minister for the Economy.
1149/2025 makes the National Accreditation Authority the notifying authority.
344/2025 designates the notifying and market surveillance authorities.
1404/2025 carries the strategy into foreign policy: partnerships with the US, China, Israel, the UAE, Germany and Austria.
1405/2025 carries the strategy into education and public awareness — AI in schooling, mandatory civil service training, a Hungarian ELLIS centre.
1406/2025 carries the strategy into administration: an AI officer in every ministry by 2026-03-31, industry sandboxes, public-sector and health AI strategies.
90/2026. (V. 13.) Korm. rendelet sets out the powers of the new government's members, including the Ministry of Science and Technology.
139/2026 amends the powers decree.
139/2026 moves AI market surveillance from the Minister for the Economy and Energy to the Minister for Science and Technology.
The same amendment removes AI market surveillance from the economy portfolio.
The AI Authority is a unit within the Ministry of Science and Technology.
The Authority exercises the market surveillance function the Act created.
